title: Warm Wholesome Jamaican Pistachio Tagine
description: A nutty, crumbly, and indulgent Jamaican dish made with unsalted pistachio, featuring sugar-free-friendly flavors.
instructions: Preheat your donabe clay pot in the oven at 180°C for 10 minutes.
Grind the unsalted pistachio into a fine crumb using a food processor or mortar and pestle.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut oil, ferment-jang, and dried thyme.
Add the coconut sugar, dried cinnamon, and ground pistachio to the bowl and mix well.
Add the mixture to the preheated donabe clay pot and pour in the water and almond milk.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the warm wholesome Jamaican pistachio tagine hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
